name: Zooms
summary: Zoom levels of one image, from a wide view to an extreme close-up.

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/relight's (built by tools/build_apps.py) with Comfy-Org Qwen Image Edit 2511 INT8 ConvRot via native UNETLoader, Lightning 2511 and fal's <sks> Multiple Angles LoRA; historical examples do not measure this native INT8 profile; the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it.

inputs.label: Zoom
inputs.default: 将镜头转为特写镜头 Turn the camera to a close-up.

options.value: 将镜头大幅向后移动并转为广角镜头 Move the camera far back and turn it to a wide-angle lens.
options.label: Much wider

sets.value: <sks> front view eye-level shot wide shot. Pull much farther back with a wide-angle lens. {details}

options.value: 将镜头向前移动 Move the camera forward.
options.label: Closer

sets.value: <sks> front view eye-level shot medium shot. Move the camera a little closer. {details}
